isolatedSql.engine: PGlite isolated PostgreSQL, sequential warm reads

productionSequentialBenchmark.assessment: Above the original 300 ms aspiration but within the one-second SQL deadline and consistent with the existing 0.5-0.65 second large-wallet baseline. This was not a concurrency test.

limits: Every collector SQL transaction retains the one-second statement timeout.
The standalone collector service retains a four-connection pool and one-second acquisition timeout.
No new database index was needed and no concurrency load was run against production.
